name: Ratio as parts of a whole
definition: A ratio of 2 to 3 means the whole splits into five equal parts, two of one kind and three of the other. Once you find what one part is worth, everything else follows. Confusing a part with the whole is the classic way this goes wrong.
recognizeWhen: the ratio of red to blue is
for every three of one there are two of the other
share an amount in the ratio
the two groups are in proportion
misconceptions: I divided the total by 2 and by 3 separately instead of by the five parts.
I treated the ratio two to three as meaning two out of three.
I found the value of one part and then forgot to multiply it back up.
